title: Hook: Day 1 of the zoo (kopie struktury vzorového virálního videa)

lines.text: Day one of the zoo that only grows when you follow.
And every visitor brings ten coins!
But we are broke. One alpaca paddock, a flamingo puddle, and no fence!
One escaped alpaca, and the zoo is over.
So we spent two hundred of our five hundred coins on a fence.
Now you decide what we build next. Most liked comment wins!
And every share sends a school bus with twenty coins.
What should we call our zoo? Follow to visit!
